ruleDefinitions.name: Control Panel Items
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the malicious use of a control panel item

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\reg\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "reg\.exe") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*add.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*CurrentVersion\\\\Control\\ Panel\\\\CPLs.*"))) OR (process_command_line = RGX("\\\.cpl$") AND  NOT ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\System32\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\%System\\%.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\|C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\system32\\|.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*regsvr32\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\/s\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*igfxCPL\\\.cpl.*"))))
